Malyn Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyrska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the older of Malyn's two Jewish cemeteries, its surviving gravestones spanning only 1908 to 1940. Densely overgrown with acacia trees to the point of being impassable, a restoration effort begun four to five years before the ESJF survey amounted only to cutting down some trees. According to local residents, several tombstones were relocated for reburial long ago by a Jewish organization, which also installed the site's ohel, though the timing of this could not be determined.
